Under the general direction of neurodiagnostic leadership, the Principal Neurodiagnostic Technologist serves as an advanced clinical specialist, subject matter expert, and technical leader within Neurodiagnostic Services. The position independently performs routine, advanced, and highly specialized neurodiagnostic procedures, including routine and ambulatory EEG, continuous long-term monitoring, scalp and stereotactic EEG monitoring, electrocorticography, ISAP/Wada, and SPECT procedures.
15% - Other Support Duties

In addition to advanced patient care, the position provides Principal-level leadership responsibilities, including ensuring technical integrity and consistency of neurodiagnostic procedures, serving as a clinical and technical resource, providing staff education and guidance, and acting as a liaison with leadership and interdepartmental partners.

The Principal Neurodiagnostic Technologist also supports EEG databases, equipment, work areas, supplies, quality improvement, and Joint Commission readiness while practicing in accordance with UC Davis Health policies, ABRET and ACNS guidelines, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements.
Must obtain ABRET CLTM credential within two (2) years of hire
Continuous Long-Term Monitoring (CLTM) credential through ABRET
Minimum four (4) years as a registered EEG/Neurodiagnostic Technologist in a hospital setting

Ability to perform advanced neurodiagnostic procedures: Electrocorticography (ECoG), Laser Ablation Surgical Monitoring (LITT), Wada Test / Intracarotid Sodium Amobarbital Procedure (Wada), Ictal Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography (SPECT), and Cortical Stimulation
